article.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
article.summary: Attackers can log in to accounts that have no password, such as SSH key-only accounts, on some Alpine Linux servers running the standard openssh-server package. They need network access to the server, an account name, and a password between 257 and 1,024 bytes long. OpenSSH, which rates the flaw critical, released version 10.6p2 today to block it. article.title: AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research
article.summary: An unreleased OpenAI cyber model found and exploited 948 distinct Linux kernel privilege escalation bugs for about $1.2 million. The post AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research appeared first on SecurityWeek .

article.title: Russian state-linked hackers target iPhone, Android devices in zero-click espionage campaign
article.summary: Russian state-linked hackers targeted users in Ukraine, the United States and Europe in a campaign to steal sensitive information from iPhone and Android devices, researchers found.

article.title: Researchers Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Exfiltrate Chats Without User Interaction

article.title: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441)
article.summary: Zyxel GS1900 series network switches that received a fix for a flaw that was later reported to have been exploited in the wild are still open to an exploit attackers used, Binarly found. That’s because the patch fixed a different bug (CVE-2026-7273) from the one (CVE-2026-107441) the exploit actually relies on.
